{{Quote|You who have no family, come to join the family of Niya-Ton, who birthed Zhi-Ton under the Prophecy of Ten Thousand Seeds.|Phi-Ton|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
The '''Prophecy of Ten Thousand Seeds''' was one of many prophecies made by [[Voss Mystics]] of [[Voss]]. [[Phi-Ton]] claimed that the birth of [[Zhi-Ton]] by [[Niya-Ton]] was in accordance with the prophecy.
